Tests whether x is greater than y. Real numeric, Boolean, String, Timestamp or Enum leaves; matching-rank arrays/clusters and scalar lifting. Complex numbers and Paths are rejected. Elements mode preserves the Boolean shape; Aggregates mode returns one Boolean.

## Types and connection rules

Real numeric, Boolean, String, Timestamp or Enum leaves; matching-rank arrays/clusters and scalar lifting. Complex numbers and Paths are rejected. Elements mode preserves the Boolean shape; Aggregates mode returns one Boolean.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.polymorphic.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `shape_preserving`.

**Input count:** 2; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.
